## Summary

`uv run --no-project` ignores the current project but still uses the local `.python-version` file at the **root of the current workspace**, overriding the global Python version configured by `uv python pin --global`.

Please make `--no-project` ignore the workspace-root `.python-version` and use the global pin from `~/.config/uv/.python-version` instead.

Normal `uv run` commands should continue respecting the workspace-root `.python-version`, while an explicit `--python` argument should always take precedence.
title: `uv run --no-project` should  ignore workspace-root `.python-version` files
